Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale<>null and
		self.CurrentStore<>null and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=self.CurrentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		self.CurrentSale.Belongedstore = self.CurrentStore and
		self.CurrentSale.Time = Now and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
		CashPayment.allInstances()->exists(p: CashPayment|p.oclIsNew() and
		p.AmountTendered = amount and
		p.Balance = amount-self.CurrentSale.Amount and
		p.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and
		self.CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = p and
		Payment.allInstances()->includes(p))
}
